en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Salim, from Al Mufazzal,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, (the narrator says) ’I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Who Washed (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup> (for funeral)?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That was Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>’, and it was as if I took that as grievous from his<sup>asws</sup> words. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is as if you<sup>asws</sup> are constricted with what I<sup>asws</sup> informed you with’. So I said, ‘It has been that, may I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>!’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not be constricted, for she<sup>asws</sup> is a Truthful and none could have happened to have washed her<sup>asws</sup> except for a Truthful. Do you not know that Maryam<sup>as</sup>, no one washed her<sup>as</sup> (for funeral) except for Isa<sup>as</sup>?’.
